hook: Here's exactly how to clear 9 hours of sleep debt…
caption: Travel, then getting sick. This is the order I did things in, and the Saturday habit that sets most people back.
notes: RECOVERY ARC. The chart has a beginning and an end, which the RHR one doesn't. Lead the account with this.

slides.text: Here's exactly how to clear 9 hours of sleep debt…

slides.caption: Oura sleep debt, Aug 16 to Sep 6. Peak 9h40m on Aug 27, against a 7h26m need. Back inside Low by Sep 6.

slides.text: Earlier bedtime. Not a later alarm.
slides.sub: Sleeping in moves your body clock and costs you the next night.
Hard sessions on top of debt just extend it.
It's the one input that makes recovery sleep worse while you're asleep.

slides.text: An extra hour a night, for a week.
slides.sub: Debt clears over nights. Not in one long one.
After travel this is what re-anchors the clock.

slides.text: The twelve hour Saturday made it worse.
slides.sub: Felt incredible. Pushed my bedtime two hours late and I paid for it until Tuesday.

slides.text: Melatonin is a timing signal, not a sedative.
slides.sub: Low dose, taken early, to drag a travel-shifted clock back. More doesn't work better.

slides.text: The line came down because of hours in bed.
i can tell you the order i did things in. i can't tell you which one did it.
slides.sub: neither can anyone else, from the outside. Ren runs them one at a time against your own baseline until the answer is a number. link in bio.
